'''Batza''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] male under the employ of [[Veedrig]] during the time of the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. After Veedrig was deposed of his position as project lead of Project Failsafe, the young Twi'lek was given more useful responsibilities on the construction of [[the Ark]].
